ontology.governedTargetSpecification: Meaning owned by an organization or other valid authority.
ontology.publisherTargetImplementationIdentity: One publisher physical face/design lineage; packaging, quantity, color, material, and adhesive variants do not automatically create identities.
ontology.commercialTargetOffering: One sellable target configuration, including legitimate quantity, material, color, adhesive, packaging, SKU, or other exposed variant.
ontology.nonTargetCommercialRecord: Accessory, consumable, stand/hardware-only product, merchandise, or non-individual-target bundle.
ontology.governingRule: Governed specification != publisher implementation identity != commercial offering.
